let usage () =
  prerr_endline "usage: app <port>";
  exit 2

let () =
  match Sys.argv with
  | [| _; port |] -> (
      match int_of_string_opt port with
      | Some p when p > 0 && p < 65536 -> (
          try Kvhttp.Server.run Unix.inet_addr_loopback p
          with Unix.Unix_error (e, fn, _) ->
            Printf.eprintf "app: %s: %s\n%!" fn (Unix.error_message e);
            exit 1)
      | Some _ | None -> usage ())
  | _ -> usage ()

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds an optimized release binary at ./app. Only the OCaml compiler,
# dune and the libraries distributed with OCaml (unix, threads) are needed.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
dune build --profile release ./bin/main.exe
cp -f _build/default/bin/main.exe ./app
chmod +x ./app

(lang dune 3.25)

(name kvhttp)

(generate_opam_files true)

(package
 (name kvhttp)
 (synopsis "In-memory HTTP/1.1 key-value server")
 (depends
  (ocaml (>= 5.3))
  dune))

type t = {
  meth : string;
  path : string;
  headers : (string * string) list;
  body : string;
}

type error = [ `Eof | `Bad_request | `Header_too_large | `Body_too_large ]

let max_line = 8192
let max_header_lines = 100

(* Upper bound on an oversized body we are willing to drain before replying. *)
let max_drain = 16 * 1024 * 1024

exception Line_too_long

(* Reads a line terminated by LF (an optional preceding CR is stripped).
   Returns [None] on EOF before any byte. *)
let input_line_bounded ic =
  let b = Buffer.create 128 in
  let rec loop () =
    match In_channel.input_char ic with
    | None -> if Buffer.length b = 0 then None else Some (Buffer.contents b)
    | Some '\n' ->
        let n = Buffer.length b in
        if n > 0 && Char.equal (Buffer.nth b (n - 1)) '\r' then
          Buffer.truncate b (n - 1);
        Some (Buffer.contents b)
    | Some c ->
        if Buffer.length b >= max_line then raise Line_too_long;
        Buffer.add_char b c;
        loop ()
  in
  loop ()

let parse_request_line line =
  match String.split_on_char ' ' line with
  | [ meth; target; version ]
    when meth <> "" && target <> "" && String.starts_with ~prefix:"HTTP/" version
    ->
      let path =
        match String.index_opt target '?' with
        | Some i -> String.sub target 0 i
        | None -> target
      in
      Ok (meth, path)
  | _ -> Error `Bad_request

let parse_header line =
  match String.index_opt line ':' with
  | Some i when i > 0 ->
      let name = String.lowercase_ascii (String.sub line 0 i) in
      let value =
        String.trim (String.sub line (i + 1) (String.length line - i - 1))
      in
      Ok (name, value)
  | Some _ | None -> Error `Bad_request

let rec read_headers ic acc count =
  if count > max_header_lines then Error `Header_too_large
  else
    match input_line_bounded ic with
    | None -> Error `Bad_request
    | Some "" -> Ok (List.rev acc)
    | Some line -> (
        match parse_header line with
        | Ok h -> read_headers ic (h :: acc) (count + 1)
        | Error _ as e -> e)

let content_length headers =
  match List.filter (fun (k, _) -> String.equal k "content-length") headers with
  | [] -> Ok 0
  | (_, v) :: rest -> (
      let all_same = List.for_all (fun (_, v') -> String.equal v v') rest in
      let digits = v <> "" && String.for_all Char.Ascii.is_digit v in
      match int_of_string_opt v with
      | Some n when all_same && digits && n >= 0 -> Ok n
      | Some _ | None -> Error `Bad_request)

let rec drain ic n =
  if n > 0 then begin
    let chunk = min n 65536 in
    let s = really_input_string ic chunk in
    ignore s;
    drain ic (n - chunk)
  end

let read_body ic ~max_body headers =
  if List.exists (fun (k, _) -> String.equal k "transfer-encoding") headers
  then Error `Bad_request
  else
    match content_length headers with
    | Error _ as e -> e
    | Ok n when n > max_body ->
        if n <= max_drain then drain ic n;
        Error `Body_too_large
    | Ok n -> Ok (really_input_string ic n)

let read ~max_body ic : (t, error) result =
  let ( let* ) = Result.bind in
  try
    match input_line_bounded ic with
    | None -> Error `Eof
    | Some line ->
        let* meth, path = parse_request_line line in
        let* headers = read_headers ic [] 0 in
        let* body = read_body ic ~max_body headers in
        Ok { meth; path; headers; body }
  with
  | Line_too_long -> Error `Header_too_large
  | End_of_file -> Error `Bad_request

(** Minimal HTTP/1.1 request parser (one request per connection). *)

type t = {
  meth : string;
  path : string;  (** Request target without any query string. *)
  headers : (string * string) list;  (** Names lower-cased. *)
  body : string;
}

type error =
  [ `Eof  (** Connection closed before a request line arrived. *)
  | `Bad_request
  | `Header_too_large
  | `Body_too_large ]

val read : max_body:int -> in_channel -> (t, error) result
(** Reads one request. Bodies longer than [max_body] are discarded (when
    reasonably small, so the client still receives the error response) and
    reported as [`Body_too_large]. *)

type t = { status : int; headers : (string * string) list; body : string }

let make ?(headers = []) ?(body = "") status = { status; headers; body }

let reason = function
  | 200 -> "OK"
  | 201 -> "Created"
  | 204 -> "No Content"
  | 400 -> "Bad Request"
  | 404 -> "Not Found"
  | 405 -> "Method Not Allowed"
  | 408 -> "Request Timeout"
  | 413 -> "Content Too Large"
  | 431 -> "Request Header Fields Too Large"
  | 500 -> "Internal Server Error"
  | 501 -> "Not Implemented"
  | _ -> "Unknown"

let serialize { status; headers; body } =
  let b = Buffer.create (128 + String.length body) in
  Printf.bprintf b "HTTP/1.1 %d %s\r\n" status (reason status);
  List.iter (fun (k, v) -> Printf.bprintf b "%s: %s\r\n" k v) headers;
  (* 204 must not carry a body; Content-Length: 0 is still accepted. *)
  Printf.bprintf b "Content-Length: %d\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n"
    (String.length body);
  Buffer.add_string b body;
  Buffer.contents b

(** HTTP responses. *)

type t = { status : int; headers : (string * string) list; body : string }

val make : ?headers:(string * string) list -> ?body:string -> int -> t
val reason : int -> string

val serialize : t -> string
(** Full HTTP/1.1 wire form, with [Content-Length] and [Connection: close]. *)

let max_value_size = 1 lsl 20
let max_key_length = 64

let is_key_char = function
  | 'A' .. 'Z' | 'a' .. 'z' | '0' .. '9' | '_' | '-' -> true
  | _ -> false

let valid_key k =
  let n = String.length k in
  n >= 1 && n <= max_key_length && String.for_all is_key_char k

let json_string_list keys =
  let b = Buffer.create 256 in
  Buffer.add_char b '[';
  List.iteri
    (fun i k ->
      if i > 0 then Buffer.add_char b ',';
      (* Keys are restricted to [A-Za-z0-9_-], so no escaping is needed. *)
      Buffer.add_char b '"';
      Buffer.add_string b k;
      Buffer.add_char b '"')
    keys;
  Buffer.add_char b ']';
  Buffer.contents b

let method_not_allowed allowed =
  Response.make ~headers:[ ("Allow", String.concat ", " allowed) ] 405

let text body =
  Response.make ~headers:[ ("Content-Type", "text/plain") ] ~body 200

type route = Health | List_keys | Item of string | Bad_key | Unknown

let route_of_path path =
  match path with
  | "/health" -> Health
  | "/kv" -> List_keys
  | _ -> (
      match String.split_first ~sep:"/kv/" path with
      | Some ("", key) -> if valid_key key then Item key else Bad_key
      | Some _ | None -> Unknown)

let handle store ~meth ~path ~body =
  match route_of_path path with
  | Unknown -> Response.make 404
  | Bad_key -> Response.make 400
  | Health -> (
      match meth with "GET" -> text "ok" | _ -> method_not_allowed [ "GET" ])
  | List_keys -> (
      match meth with
      | "GET" ->
          Response.make
            ~headers:[ ("Content-Type", "application/json") ]
            ~body:(json_string_list (Store.keys store))
            200
      | _ -> method_not_allowed [ "GET" ])
  | Item key -> (
      match meth with
      | "GET" -> (
          match Store.get store key with
          | Some v ->
              Response.make
                ~headers:[ ("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream") ]
                ~body:v 200
          | None -> Response.make 404)
      | "PUT" ->
          if String.length body > max_value_size then Response.make 413
          else (
            match Store.put store key body with
            | `Created -> Response.make 201
            | `Replaced -> Response.make 200)
      | "DELETE" ->
          if Store.delete store key then Response.make 204
          else Response.make 404
      | _ -> method_not_allowed [ "GET"; "PUT"; "DELETE" ])

(** Maps a parsed request onto the key-value store. *)

val max_value_size : int
(** Largest accepted value, in bytes (1 MiB). *)

val valid_key : string -> bool
(** [valid_key k] holds iff [k] matches [[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}]. *)

val handle : Store.t -> meth:string -> path:string -> body:string -> Response.t

let io_timeout = 30.

let rec write_all fd s off len =
  if len > 0 then begin
    let n = Unix.write_substring fd s off len in
    write_all fd s (off + n) (len - n)
  end

let respond_error = function
  | `Bad_request -> Some (Response.make 400)
  | `Header_too_large -> Some (Response.make 431)
  | `Body_too_large -> Some (Response.make 413)
  | `Eof -> None

let log_exn e =
  Printf.eprintf "kvhttp: connection error: %s\n%!" (Printexc.to_string e)

let serve store fd =
  Unix.setsockopt_float fd Unix.SO_RCVTIMEO io_timeout;
  Unix.setsockopt_float fd Unix.SO_SNDTIMEO io_timeout;
  let ic = Unix.in_channel_of_descr fd in
  let response =
    match Request.read ~max_body:Router.max_value_size ic with
    | Ok { meth; path; body; headers = _ } ->
        Some (Router.handle store ~meth ~path ~body)
    | Error e -> respond_error e
  in
  Option.iter
    (fun r ->
      let wire = Response.serialize r in
      write_all fd wire 0 (String.length wire))
    response

let handle_connection store fd =
  Fun.protect
    ~finally:(fun () -> try Unix.close fd with Unix.Unix_error _ -> ())
    (fun () ->
      try serve store fd with
      | Unix.Unix_error ((EPIPE | ECONNRESET | EAGAIN | EWOULDBLOCK), _, _)
      | Sys_error _ ->
          (* Client went away or timed out; nothing useful to report. *)
          ()
      | Unix.Unix_error _ as e -> log_exn e)

let rec accept_loop store sock =
  match Unix.accept ~cloexec:true sock with
  | fd, _ ->
      ignore (Thread.create (handle_connection store) fd : Thread.t);
      accept_loop store sock
  | exception Unix.Unix_error ((EINTR | ECONNABORTED | EAGAIN), _, _) ->
      accept_loop store sock
  | exception (Unix.Unix_error ((EMFILE | ENFILE), _, _) as e) ->
      log_exn e;
      Thread.delay 0.05;
      accept_loop store sock

let run ?(backlog = 1024) addr port =
  Sys.set_signal Sys.sigpipe Sys.Signal_ignore;
  let sock = Unix.socket ~cloexec:true Unix.PF_INET Unix.SOCK_STREAM 0 in
  Unix.setsockopt sock Unix.SO_REUSEADDR true;
  Unix.bind sock (Unix.ADDR_INET (addr, port));
  Unix.listen sock backlog;
  accept_loop (Store.create ()) sock

(** Thread-per-connection HTTP server over the key-value store. *)

val handle_connection : Store.t -> Unix.file_descr -> unit
(** Serves one request on [fd] and closes it. Never raises on I/O errors. *)

val run : ?backlog:int -> Unix.inet_addr -> int -> unit
(** [run addr port] listens on [addr:port] and serves forever. *)

(** Thread-safe in-memory key-value store. *)

type t

val create : unit -> t

val put : t -> string -> string -> [ `Created | `Replaced ]
(** [put t k v] binds [k] to [v]. *)

val get : t -> string -> string option
val delete : t -> string -> bool
(** [delete t k] is [true] if [k] was bound. *)

val keys : t -> string list
(** All keys, sorted ascending (byte order). *)
